task.description: Write ExUnit tests covering Letflow.TenantProvisioning.replay_all_pending/0 (new) and Letflow.TenantProvisioning.MigrationReplayBoot (new), per WF-03's regression-test rule: since this fix ADDS new functions rather than changing existing behavior, the fail-then-pass rule is satisfied only via the MUTATION-TESTING path (see docs/agents/workflows/WF-03_issue_resolving.md, 'When the pre-fix failure is code under test does not exist' section) -- your tests must be proven SENSITIVE to the specific traps this fix exists to prevent, not merely passing against the shipped implementation. Cover at minimum: (1) idempotent no-op second run -- calling replay_all_pending/0 twice against tenants with zero pending migrations produces the same %{ok: [...], error: []} result both times with no duplicate DDL/rows; (2) one tenant's migration failure does not abort replay for other tenants -- construct a fixture where one tenant's migration state is broken (e.g. a corrupt/unreachable schema or a migration that raises) and confirm the OTHER tenants still get replayed and appear under :ok while the broken one appears under :error, in the same call; (3) a real replay against a genuinely pending tenant-scoped migration in a test fixture -- provision a tenant, then simulate a migration that was added AFTER provisioning (not yet applied to that tenant's schema), call replay_all_pending/0, and confirm it actually applies and the tenant ends up under :ok. result.summary:
Test code itself is DONE and DEMONSTRATED SENSITIVE via mutation testing (see below) -- but I cannot report PASS on this handoff because a NEW, SEPARATE, BLOCKING DEFECT in the step-05-REVIEWER-gated shipped code (commit 9cda33ed, unchanged since) prevents `mix test` -- or `Letflow.Application.start/2` at all, in ANY form (mix test, mix phx.server, iex -S mix, a release) -- from booting in THIS checkout. This is not a defect in my tests; it is a pre-existing gap in lib/ that slipped through ELIXIR-DEV (step 03, which only ran `mix compile --warnings-as-errors` and `mix format --check-formatted`, never `mix test` or any real boot), SECURITY-REVIEWER (step 04), and REVIEWER (step 05, which reviewed the diff by reading, never by running it) -- see step-03/04/05 handoffs' own result.summary, none mention running `mix test` or booting the app.

THE DEFECT: lib/letflow/supervisor/infrastructure.ex adds `Letflow.TenantProvisioning.MigrationReplayBoot` to its `init/1` children list in bare-module form (line ~191), which requires the module to implement `child_spec/1`. It does not -- migration_replay_boot.ex defines only `start_link/1` (deliberately not a GenServer/Supervisor/Task per the design doc, so it gets no auto-generated child_spec/1 either). Reproduced directly and repeatedly in this checkout: `mix test test/letflow/tenant_provisioning_test.exs` raises `** (ArgumentError) The module Letflow.TenantProvisioning.MigrationReplayBoot was given as a child to a supervisor but it does not implement child_spec/1`, which crashes `Letflow.Supervisor.Infrastructure.start_link/1`, which `Letflow.Application.start/2` reports as `shutdown: failed to start child: Letflow.Supervisor.Infrastructure`, and `mix test` aborts with exit code 1 before running a single test -- for this file AND for every other test file in the suite, since `mix test` starts the whole OTP application first. `mix compile --warnings-as-errors` (exit 0) and `mix format --check-formatted` (exit 0) both pass cleanly in this checkout precisely because neither of them boots the application -- which is exactly why ELIXIR-DEV's step-03 verification, run only via those two commands, could not have caught this.

WHY THIS IS SEVERITY-BLOCKER, NOT MINOR: this is strictly worse than ISS-0771 itself. ISS-0771's own bug was a SILENT gap (migrations just didn't replay). This bug takes the ENTIRE APPLICATION DOWN on every single boot -- QA, prod, local dev, `iex -S mix`, a release -- with no silent failure mode at all; nothing serves any request. If this were deployed as-is, it would be a second, immediate, total outage layered directly on top of the incident this fix exists to close.

WHAT I DID NOT DO: did not add `child_spec/1` (or any other fix) to lib/ in this checkout or commit it -- out of TEST-DESIGNER's mandate (task explicitly: 'Do NOT implement the fix ... test code only'), and this is ELIXIR-DEV/REVIEWER's gate to re-run, not mine to silently patch around.

WHAT I DID TO STILL PRODUCE REAL, VERIFIED TEST EVIDENCE: wrote the full test suite (test/letflow/tenant_provisioning_test.exs new describe block 'replay_all_pending/0 (ISS-0771)', 3 tests; test/letflow/tenant_provisioning/migration_replay_boot_test.exs, new file, 2 tests; test/specs/ISS-0771.md). Confirmed `mix compile --warnings-as-errors` exit 0 and `mix format --check-formatted` exit 0 for both test files in THIS checkout (real output: both commands produced no output and exited 0). To actually RUN the 5 new tests and the mutation-testing evidence WF-03's 'code under test does not exist' path requires (this fix adds brand-new functions, so fail-then-pass is trivially satisfied and proves nothing -- mutation testing is the real evidence), created a THROWAWAY git worktree off this branch's exact HEAD (248f77c8) at .claude/worktrees/iss0771-childspec-shim (removed after use, `git worktree remove --force`), copied the 3 new/changed test files into it unchanged, and added ONE throwaway line there ONLY -- a minimal `child_spec/1` on MigrationReplayBoot, explicitly commented 'THROWAWAY TEST-DESIGNER SHIM -- ISS0771-CHILDSPEC-SHIM-DO-NOT-COMMIT' -- solely so the OTP app could boot far enough to run tests at all. This shim was never committed and never touched this checkout; confirmed via `git diff --stat 9cda33ed -- lib/` in THIS checkout returning empty (zero diff against the REVIEWER-gated tree) both before and after the throwaway-worktree work.

UNMUTATED RESULT (throwaway worktree, shim applied, real Postgres, real mix test): `mix test test/letflow/tenant_provisioning_test.exs test/letflow/tenant_provisioning/migration_replay_boot_test.exs` -> 'Finished in 5.2 seconds (0.00s async, 5.2s sync)' / 'Result: 23 passed' / exit 0. All 5 new tests present and green (confirmed individually via --trace): 'replay_all_pending/0 (ISS-0771) calling it twice against a fully migrated tenant is a safe no-op both times', '... one tenant's broken schema does not abort replay for a healthy sibling tenant', '... actually applies a migration that is pending against an already-provisioned tenant', 'start_link/1 returns :ignore and logs the failing tenant even when a tenant's replay fails', 'start_link/1 logs a 0-failed summary line on the healthy path'. The other 18 are REQ-022's pre-existing tests, unaffected.

MUTATION TESTING (technique: apply-in-throwaway-worktree, the WF-03-preferred technique -- lib/ in THIS checkout was never mutated at all): Mutant 1 (targets design doc §4 Layer-2 per-tenant isolation guarantee) -- removed replay_all_pending/0's own per-tenant `rescue` around `replay_migrations(tenant_id)` in the Enum.reduce, AND changed replay_migrations/2's own Layer-1 rescue to `reraise exception, __STACKTRACE__` instead of returning `{:error, {:migration_failed, exception}}` (necessary because Layer 1 alone already catches everything reachable today, so Layer 2's removal is otherwise unobservable -- this combined mutant is exactly the 'a future change to replay_migrations/2 reintroduces an unrescued raise path' scenario design doc §4 names as the reason Layer 2 exists). Result: 21/23 passed, 2 failed -- exactly the two tests targeting isolation: 'one tenant's broken schema does not abort replay for a healthy sibling tenant' (crashed with `** (Postgrex.Error) ... schema ... does not exist`, uncaught, proving the sibling tenant's iteration never got a chance to run) and 'start_link/1 returns :ignore and logs the failing tenant ...' (the specific per-tenant `tenant migration replay failed:` log line never appeared, because the raise skipped straight to start_link/1's own outermost catch-all instead). All other 21 tests, including the OTHER 3 new ISS-0771 tests, stayed green -- confirms Layer 2 is load-bearing, not decorative, and confirms these two tests specifically are sensitive to its removal. Reverted via `git checkout -- lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning.ex` in the throwaway worktree; confirmed `git status --porcelain lib/` showed only the still-in-place child_spec shim file, tenant_provisioning.ex clean.

Mutant 2 (targets design doc §2.2/§3 'always returns :ignore' guarantee) -- removed start_link/1's outer try/rescue entirely and made it call run_replay!/0 directly, where run_replay!/0 now `raise`s when `error != []` instead of always returning `:ignore` -- i.e. start_link/1 now genuinely propagates a crash on any tenant failure, the exact regression the design doc's §1 'What could still go wrong' section calls the single highest-severity failure mode ('a single broken tenant migration would fail Letflow.Supervisor.Infrastructure's own Supervisor.start_link/2 and take the entire application down on every boot'). Result: 22/23 passed, 1 failed -- exactly 'start_link/1 returns :ignore and logs the failing tenant even when a tenant's replay fails', with `** (RuntimeError) boot replay failed for 1 tenant(s)` raised directly out of start_link/1 instead of :ignore being returned -- confirms this test is the one sensitive to exactly this regression. All other 22 tests, including the other 4 new ISS-0771 tests, stayed green. Reverted via `git checkout -- lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning/migration_replay_boot.ex` in the throwaway worktree (this also removed the throwaway child_spec shim, which is fine -- the worktree was deleted immediately afterward with `git worktree remove --force`, never merged, never pushed).

CONFIRMATION THIS CHECKOUT'S lib/ WAS NEVER TOUCHED: `git status --porcelain` in this checkout (WF03-ISS0771-20260921) at the time of writing this summary shows only `M test/letflow/tenant_provisioning_test.exs`, `?? test/letflow/tenant_provisioning/migration_replay_boot_test.exs`, `?? test/specs/ISS-0771.md` -- no lib/ entries at all. `git diff --stat 9cda33ed -- lib/` (9cda33ed = the commit REVIEWER's step-05 PASS gated) returns completely empty output -- zero bytes changed in lib/ relative to the REVIEWER-gated state. Both mutants existed only inside the now-deleted `.claude/worktrees/iss0771-childspec-shim` worktree.

RECOMMENDATION TO ORCH: this handoff cannot route forward to TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR as PASS, because TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR's own mandate (independently re-run at least one reported mutant, per WF-03's 'code under test does not exist' rule) would hit the identical boot failure against this checkout's actual committed lib/ -- there is nothing for it to validate against until the child_spec/1 gap is fixed. Recommend: route BACK to ELIXIR-DEV (a rework of step 03, or a fresh REWORK step) with the fix scoped narrowly -- add `child_spec/1` to Letflow.TenantProvisioning.MigrationReplayBoot (a `restart: :temporary` map-form child_spec is sufficient, matching this one-shot module's own semantics, OR convert infrastructure.ex's children-list entry to explicit map/tuple form referencing start_link/1 directly) -- then re-run SECURITY-REVIEWER (step 04) and REVIEWER (step 05) against that narrow diff (both gates already passed everything else in this diff; only the new one-function fix needs re-review), then re-dispatch TEST-DESIGNER (this step) to re-run `mix test` directly against the corrected, committed checkout (no shim needed at that point) and confirm the same 23/23 result for real, in-branch. My test files (test/specs/ISS-0771.md, test/letflow/tenant_provisioning_test.exs's new describe block, test/letflow/tenant_provisioning/migration_replay_boot_test.exs) need no changes for that re-run -- they already pass cleanly once the module can boot, as demonstrated above.

issues.description: lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning/migration_replay_boot.ex's MigrationReplayBoot module is wired into lib/letflow/supervisor/infrastructure.ex's init/1 children list in bare-module form but never implements child_spec/1 (it is deliberately not a GenServer/Supervisor/Task, per the design doc, so none is auto-generated). Letflow.Application.start/2 therefore crashes on EVERY boot -- mix test, mix phx.server, iex -S mix, and a release alike -- with `** (ArgumentError) ... does not implement child_spec/1`, reproduced directly in this checkout. Slipped through ELIXIR-DEV (step 03: only ran mix compile/mix format, never mix test or a real boot), SECURITY-REVIEWER (step 04), and REVIEWER (step 05: reviewed the diff by reading, not by running it). Strictly worse than ISS-0771's own original silent-gap bug -- this one takes the whole application down loudly, immediately, on every boot, with no silent failure mode. Fix: add a minimal child_spec/1 to MigrationReplayBoot (restart: :temporary, matching its one-shot semantics), or wire it into infrastructure.ex's children list via explicit map/tuple form instead of bare-module form. Not fixed here (TEST-DESIGNER's mandate is test code only) -- blocking this handoff from proceeding to TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR until ELIXIR-DEV/REVIEWER re-run against the fix.
